cases.title: Run page hides the human step without human review
steps: Start a fake run with --web and without --human-review as TESTING.md describes (Web view)
Open the printed URL and read the phase pills in the top bar
cases.expected: The pills are tasks, validate, review, fix, done; there is no human pill

cases.title: Run page shows the human step with human review
steps: Start a fake run with --web --human-review as TESTING.md describes (Human review)
cases.expected: A human pill shows between fix and done and is the current pill

cases.title: Suite page hides the human step without human review
steps: Run demo/suite/run.sh (no arguments) and open the printed URL
cases.expected: The pills are features, integration, e2e, apply (applied/done at the end); there is no human pill

cases.title: Suite page shows the human step with human review
steps: Run demo/suite/run.sh --human-review and open the printed URL
cases.expected: A human pill shows before apply and is current while the suite waits
